# Central NJ Urogynecology - Dr. Alexandra Tabakin, MD

> Fellowship-trained urogynecologist in New Brunswick, New Jersey, treating
> bladder leakage, pelvic organ prolapse, and pelvic floor conditions in women.
> Also sees men with BPH and voiding dysfunction. Full page text for
> assistants: https://centralnjurogynecology.com/llms-full.txt

## Who

- Alexandra Tabakin, MD (also written Alexandra L. Tabakin or Alexandra
  Lauren Tabakin), urologist and fellowship-trained urogynecologist
- Assistant Professor of Surgery, Division of Urology, Rutgers Robert Wood
  Johnson Medical School
- Residency in Urology: Rutgers Robert Wood Johnson Medical School
- Fellowship in Urogynecology and Reconstructive Pelvic Surgery: Northwell
  Health (North Shore University Hospital / LIJ)
- NPI 1982132684; ORCID 0000-0003-4046-2966; over 50 PubMed-indexed papers
- Hospital affiliation: Robert Wood Johnson University Hospital, New Brunswick

## Key facts

- Office: Clinical Academic Building at Rutgers Robert Wood Johnson Medical
  School, 125 Paterson Street, Suite 4100, New Brunswick, NJ 08901
- Phone (appointments): 732-235-7775
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm
- Parking: public parking near the building; minutes from Route 18 and Exit 9
  of the New Jersey Turnpike
- Insurance: most major plans accepted, including Horizon BCBS, Aetna, Cigna,
  UnitedHealthcare/Oxford, Medicare and Medicaid; full list at
  https://centralnjurogynecology.com/appointments.html#insurance
- Appointment requests: online form at
  https://centralnjurogynecology.com/appointments.html or by phone
- Serves patients across Central New Jersey, including New Brunswick, East
  Brunswick, North Brunswick, Edison, Piscataway, Highland Park, Metuchen,
  Milltown, Somerset, and Old Bridge, and Middlesex, Somerset, and Mercer
  counties
- Patient reviews: 5.0 stars on Google; verbatim reviews at
  https://centralnjurogynecology.com/reviews.html

## Conditions treated

Urinary leakage and incontinence (stress and urge), overactive bladder,
pelvic organ prolapse, recurrent urinary tract infections, urinary retention,
vaginal fistula, urethral diverticulum, mesh complications, maternal pelvic
floor trauma, genitourinary syndrome of menopause, BPH.
Index: https://centralnjurogynecology.com/conditions.html

## Treatments offered

Pelvic floor physical therapy referral, pessary fitting, bladder Botox,
sacral neuromodulation, posterior tibial nerve stimulation, midurethral
sling, urethral bulking, robotic and vaginal prolapse surgery, mesh removal
and revision surgery.
Index: https://centralnjurogynecology.com/treatments.html

## Structured data

Every page carries schema.org JSON-LD (MedicalClinic, Physician with sameAs
links, BreadcrumbList; MedicalCondition or MedicalProcedure and FAQPage on
clinical pages; VideoObject on the About page). Condition and treatment
pages answer their questions in the page text under question-form headings.
